name: motion-video
description: Code-rendered motion films with Three.js, deterministic frame seeking, Playwright, local Web Audio and verified ffmpeg export.

interface.shortDescription: Animate in code. Render and verify the MP4.
interface.longDescription: Create reusable motion films from a product or creative brief. Includes a local Three.js starter, a pure renderAt(t) contract, frame-by-frame Playwright rendering, synthesized audio, contact sheets, deterministic seek checks and verification of the encoded video and audio.
